prerequisites.title: Xero developer account and app
prerequisites.detail: You need a Xero app on the developer dashboard to get a client ID and secret. Add the redirect URI first, since the client ID is only visible after that.

prerequisites.title: Decide your scopes
prerequisites.detail: You must choose the scopes your application needs before requesting access.

prerequisites.title: Security standard readiness
prerequisites.detail: Requirements cover API risk rating, authentication, personnel security, encryption and audit logging. Two-step authentication is the minimum, and is covered if you use Sign in with Xero.

steps.title: Create Xero app and add redirect URI
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer dashboard, create the app and add the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard. Then view the client ID and generate the client secret.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Draft scope list and justification
steps.detail: Agent lists the minimum scopes your product needs and writes a short justification for each.
steps.done_when: Scope list is ready to enter in the app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Agent creates the auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Prepare security assessment answers
steps.detail: Agent drafts answers against the Xero security standard: authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit security assessment
steps.detail: Review the drafted answers, confirm them, and submit as the accountable person.

steps.title: Wait for Xero security review
steps.detail: Xero emails whether you passed. If not, you get a remediation report, then 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement.

traps.title: Unclear if review blocks outside customers
traps.detail: The docs say apps are not certified or listed without passing, but do not clearly say unreviewed apps cannot connect customers. Confirm with Xero before promising a launch date.

traps.title: Failing review adds up to 90 days
traps.detail: A failed assessment brings a remediation report, then 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement. Xero then re-reviews.

traps.title: Assessment repeats every year
traps.detail: The security assessment must be done annually, so budget for recurring work.

traps.title: Redirect URI rules are strict
traps.detail: Wildcards are not allowed and the URI must be absolute. You can register up to 50.

traps.title: Rate limits are fixed per organisation
traps.detail: Each connected organisation gets 5 concurrent calls, 60 per minute and 5000 per day, and the app is capped at 10,000 per minute overall. Exceeding them returns HTTP 429, and the page says limits cannot be raised.

blockers.symptom: Xero asks for a remediation plan after review
blockers.what_it_means: The security assessment did not pass.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a plan within 30 days, implement within 60 days, then wait for re-review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Agent can draft the remediation plan from the report.

blockers.what_to_do: Back off and retry, and keep calls per organisation within limits.
blockers.agent_can_help: Agent can add retry and throttling logic.

open_questions: Can customers outside your company connect before the security assessment passes? Ask Xero developer support or check the app partner terms.
Is there a partner acceptance step for new Xero apps? Check Xero's partnerships page or ask developer support.
Do customer organisation admins need to approve the app? Not found; test with a second Xero organisation.
What is the official developer docs entry point? Not found in the dossier; check developer.xero.com.
Are there limits on connections before approval? A connection cap was mentioned only for migrated apps; ask Xero for the cap on new apps.
Not found: customer side. Checked xero.com, xero.com.
